faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know before booking your vehicle.

items.question: What do I need to rent?
items.answer: A valid driver's license, passport or ID, and a security deposit may be required. Exact requirements vary by vehicle and will be confirmed before booking.

items.question: Is insurance included?
items.answer: Coverage details and any deductible will be explained in your quote and rental agreement.

items.question: Can you deliver the vehicle?
items.answer: Delivery may be available depending on location and schedule.

items.question: How do I confirm my reservation?
items.answer: After your request, IVJ will confirm availability, total price, deposit and the steps required to secure the vehicle.

items.question: What is the fuel and cancellation policy?
items.answer: Fuel, cancellation, late-return and damage policies will be provided with your final rental terms before you confirm.
